scope: controlled application fault injection with real CPU work; fixture quality floor
scope_limits: No field latency, reliability SLA, or physical RF link is validated.
Inference assumes separately executed paired runs are independent conditional on the fixed strata.
An exposure to BUSY after another task falls back is descriptive unless the linked events support attribution.
Actual oracle delivery at or after an already public cutoff may change scheduler timing without adding information.
Discarded CPU includes the sampled user plus system CPU across the lifetimes of worker processes with unadopted output generations.
Modeled zero stop-to-reuse results are sensitivity evidence and do not enter the physical effect or gate threshold.

pivot_primary_exposures.criterion: For each direction, at least one primary B1 pair has an observed drop within its planned fallback-straddling window, a fallback event, and an admission BUSY event.
pivot_primary_exposures.held_epochs: Positive retained-slot epochs after actual fallback, shown as exposure diagnostics.

calibration.stop_source: median B2-info actual committed-cancel to postcommit reuse

limits: Simulated release events hold no physical CPU process. A canceled pure task is assumed to have no external side effects.
Both modeled arms receive the actual model-local fallback decision at zero information delay.
Grant-to-release service calibration is used as one deterministic execution duration. Service variation, startup, SQL timing and clock error are not modeled separately.
RPCs take zero simulated transport time outside the directional application fault windows. Retry spacing is represented by the planned RTO.
Modeled expiry, post-fallback publication and worker stop are idealizations. Compare modeled arm deltas only with their matched modeled control.

Per-task authority commit availability and lease validity come from the matching B2-info trace and stay fixed across both model arms. C2 exchange dynamics and feedback from changed application occupancy are outside the model.

An explicit final no-commit observation denies all modeled grants for that task. A durable commit permits grant only after its observed return and only if committed before the C2 lease limit. Application windows still affect requests and replies.

C2 proof timings are cross-checked against the retained authority trace within the observed host clock domain. Source digests bind the supplied files and require an independently retained manifest to attest their origin.
